content: To reduce the likelihood of unpleasant side effects, it is crucial to ensure that no more than 30% of the calories in your diet come from fat. Do not increase your dose or use this medication more frequently or for a longer duration than prescribed. This drug can interfere with the absorption of certain fat-soluble vitamins, including vitamins A, D, E, and K. Therefore, it is recommended to take a daily multivitamin supplement containing these nutrients. If you are taking cyclosporine, ensure that you take it at least three hours before or after orlistat to allow for proper absorption of cyclosporine into your bloodstream. You should expect to see some weight loss within two weeks of starting orlistat. Changes in bowel function are common due to the unabsorbed fat. These changes may include fatty or oily stools, oily spotting, intestinal gas with discharge, an urgent need to have a bowel movement, an increased frequency of bowel movements, or poor bowel control. These side effects may worsen if you consume more fat than recommended. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits to you outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before taking orlistat, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. If you have diabetes, weight loss may improve your blood sugar control. Be sure to monitor your blood sugar levels regularly and report the results to your doctor. This medication must not be used during pregnancy, as weight loss offers no benefit to a pregnant woman and may harm an unborn baby. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If you are taking medications to treat seizures, orlistat may reduce their effectiveness. In the event of an overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory tests, such as kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are taking this medication. Be sure to attend all medical and laboratory appointments. For optimal results, this medication should be used in conjunction with a doctor-approved exercise program and diet plan. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it has been more than one to two hours since your meal, skip the missed dose, as most of the fat from your meal will already have been absorbed, and the medication will not be effective. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
